instruction.name: vsigncov.w
instruction.description: If the 32-bit element in `a` equals to zero, set the result to zero. If the signed 32-bit element in `a` is positive, copy element in `b` to result. Otherwise, copy negated element in `b` to result. If `a` and `b` are the same vectors, it is equivalent to computing absolute value.

throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 3.99 cycles. The measured CPI 0.4988 is the nominal 0.5 within measurement noise; the value is reported as the nominal figure.

notes: LSX vector instruction. Measured on LA664 with register-only operands; latency uses a dependent chain (unroll=100000), throughput uses 8 independent lanes (unroll=1000). Both vector sources are recorded separately; they share the same result path where the hardware is symmetric. Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
